description: This file defines the PayrollPeriod class and related functions for handling payroll period validation, overlap checking, and calculations within an ERP system, specifically for payroll management.

classes.name: PayrollPeriod
classes.description: Represents a payroll period with validation for date correctness and overlap within the ERP system.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the payroll period by checking date correctness and overlaps.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Checks if start_date is before end_date.

methods.name: validate_overlap
methods.description: Checks for overlapping payroll periods within the same company.
